texto: Explain responsibilities and results and answer questions about a proposal. **Mitt förslag till nästa steg** means «This is my proposal for the next step.». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
